projects.name: DocMind
projects.description: A document intelligence platform built on a full RAG pipeline. Ingests PDFs, embeds them via sentence-transformers, stores vectors in ChromaDB, and serves answers through a Groq-backed LLaMA inference layer at low latency.

projects.name: CodeWeave
projects.description: An autonomous coding agent that resolves GitHub issues end-to-end using a plan→execute→validate loop. Streams execution state via SSE, persists task history in Supabase, and self-corrects on failing test output.

projects.name: NeuralFlow
projects.description: An ML pipeline orchestration system with canary deployment support, drift detection, and a real-time metrics dashboard. Built to explore MLOps infrastructure patterns outside managed platforms like SageMaker or Vertex.

projects.name: Codebase Atlas
projects.description: An interactive codebase visualizer that parses dependency graphs, surfaces contributor hotspots, and renders monorepo relationships as navigable D3 force graphs to support architectural decisions without digging through file trees.

projects.name: Driftless
projects.description: A distraction-free writing environment with inline AI grammar nudges and built-in version diffing. Suggestions appear without interrupting flow, and the diff view makes revisions easy to review and trust before committing.

projects.name: Meridian API
projects.description: A high-throughput geocoding and routing microservice handling 2M+ requests per day with a 99.99% uptime SLA. Engineered for sustained production load, throughput optimization, and operational reliability under real traffic.
